description: Flugplandaten des Flughafen Münster/Osnabrück (FMO) is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Open.NRW. Der Flughafen Münster/Osnabrück stellt über diesen Datensatz Informationen zur aktuellen Ankunfts- und Abflugsituation am FMO zur Verfügung. Die Daten werden als maschinenlesbare XML-Schnittstelle bereitgestellt. Aktualisierung der Flugdaten Die Flugdaten werden bei jeder Änderung aktualisiert und in der Schnittstelle zur Verfügung gestellt. Coverage: Open.NRW. The portal files it under the publisher Open.NRW. Its tags are freizeit, kultur, sport-und-tourismus, transport-und-verkehr. It offers 4 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/PDF, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/XML. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
